function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current price. We don't have real-time data. According to policy, we should not fabricate or guess. We can say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can provide approximate or typical price? But policy says we cannot provide inaccurate info. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. That would comply with policy.

We also have a tool to calculate bond price but that's irrelevant. There's no other tool. So we just answer that we can't provide real-time data.
